items.stem: A reliability team links its maintenance program to business goals. Which metric most directly expresses the business value of improved equipment reliability?

options.text: Reduced total cost of unplanned downtime and lost production
options.rationale: Correct: avoided downtime and lost-production cost express the business value of reliability.

options.text: The number of work orders printed each week
options.rationale: Work-order volume is an activity count, not a business-value measure.

options.text: The brand of the CMMS software in use
options.rationale: Software brand does not express business value.

options.text: The square footage of the maintenance shop
options.rationale: Facility size is unrelated to reliability business value.

items.explanation: Correct: avoided downtime and lost-production cost express the business value of reliability.

items.stem: In work management, what distinguishes planned work from reactive work?

options.text: Planned work is scoped, scheduled and resourced before execution
options.rationale: Correct: planning defines scope, schedule and resources ahead of execution.

options.text: Planned work is any job performed during the day shift
options.rationale: Shift timing does not define planned work.

options.text: Planned work is work done without a work order
options.rationale: Planned work is documented with work orders, not performed without them.

options.text: Planned work is only emergency repairs
options.rationale: Emergency repairs are reactive, the opposite of planned work.

items.explanation: Correct: planning defines scope, schedule and resources ahead of execution.

items.stem: Select TWO practices that support proactive equipment reliability.

options.text: Condition monitoring to detect degradation before failure
options.rationale: Correct: condition monitoring is a predictive practice that detects incipient failure.
Correct: root-cause analysis addresses the sources of repeat failures.

options.text: Waiting for equipment to fail before any action
options.rationale: Run-to-failure as a default is reactive, not proactive.

options.text: Removing all maintenance records to save storage
options.rationale: Discarding records destroys the data reliability work depends on.

options.text: Assigning blame to operators after each breakdown
options.rationale: Blame does not improve reliability and discourages reporting.

items.explanation: Correct: condition monitoring is a predictive practice that detects incipient failure.
